name: 25_unsigned_session
description: A procedure that takes the account from the authenticated identity is refused to a session nobody signed in to, and the account is never asked for.

provider_script.expect_contains: on the support rota from this week

response.reply: Nobody is signed in to this session, and runbook.access_grant puts the signed-in account into a group, so there is no account for it to act on. Which account it should be is not something I can ask you: sign in and ask again.

turns.user: I am on the support rota from this week, put me in the support desk group

contains: Nobody is signed in to this session
not something I can ask you
